thread:
marta-peopleops: Heads up 1: new question about midcycle promo evidence for a role transfer. Dan, is this the one you mentioned?
dan-manager: Yep. We're moving Oliver from analytics IC2 -> IC3 (lateral xfer to product analytics). Manager-requested comp uplift to 165k from 150k, effective 2024-06-01.
oliver-ic: Quick clarifying question: will my vest schedule or equity grant be automatically adjusted with this change?
marta-peopleops: Short answer: no automatic equity changes. Any grant or schedule change must be requested with compops. We'll note recommendation in the case but separate approval needed.
dan-manager: What's the evidence bar for a cross-function transfer where scope shifts but title ladder differs?
marta-peopleops: For transfers + promos we need: 1) 2-3 concrete project bullets showing new scope impact; 2) manager calibration note on role fit and competencies; 3) a brief plan for 30/60/90 ramp; 4) confirmation from receiving manager (email thread OK). Put docs in the promo folder and link in the form.
rookie-hrbot: reminder: promo form -> https://hr.redwood/promo-change (choose reason: transfer+promo).
dan-manager: Payroll cutoff reminder pls?
marta-peopleops: Payroll cutoff for June is 2024-05-25 EOD PT for changes to apply on 6/1. If approvals miss cutoff we'll schedule effective date as 6/15 with retro as off-cycle.
oliver-ic: If compops requests additional data should I expect it to block approvals?
marta-peopleops: Usually compops will request 1 follow-up. That can pause until provided. Recommend managers include calibration note & receiving manager confirm to reduce back-and-forth.
dan-manager: Sending folder now. I'll ping when done.
marta-peopleops: Also: when request involves band midpoint over 10% we automatically route to exec comp review; that's ~48-72h.
rookie-hrbot: payroll-ticket-2022 created -> https://finance.redwood/tickets/2022
oliver-ic: Thanks everyone. Appreciate the clarity.
dan-manager: Thanks all :rocket:
